CapturePlanDevice.description: The capture device. Every field is optional; an absent field takes its default.

end_mass_kg.description: Mass of the root and of the tail in kg. Default 2.0; greater than 0.

joint_damping_angular.description: Angular damping of each tether joint. Default 1.0; not negative.

joint_damping_linear.description: Linear damping of each tether joint. Default 1.0; not negative.

segment_mass_kg.description: Mass of each interior tether node in kg. Default 0.1; greater than 0.

segment_spacing_m.description:
Distance between tether joints in metres. Default 0.1; greater than 0, and the
tether may have at most 1,000 bodies (a warning above 200).

tether_length_m.description: Physical length of the tether in metres. Default 20.0; greater than 0.

CaptureSphere.description: The capture sphere around the target.

initial_radius_m.description: Radius in metres at the start of every capture. Default 25.0; greater than 0.

ConditionBounds.description: Bounds on one quantity; at least one, neither negative. Both strict.

greater_than.description: Holds while the quantity is above this value.

less_than.description: Holds while the quantity is below this value.

MigratedFromV0.description:
The v0 content a migration could not map, so the file can be written back
without losing it.

unmapped.description: Every unmapped v0 value with its JSON Pointer into the v0 document.

Phase.description: One phase of the plan: the controller's limits while in it and its transitions.

end.description: Marks an end phase (`success` or `abort`); an end phase has no transitions.

id.description: Phase id, unique in the plan and not blank.

max_force_n.description: Force applied to each tether node in N; not negative.

max_velocity_mps.description: Speed limit of the tether nodes in m/s; not negative.

shrink_rate_mps.description: Rate at which the capture sphere shrinks in m/s; not negative. Absent: no shrink.

transitions.description: Checked in order every step; the first whose conditions all hold fires.

PhaseEnd.description: How an end phase ends the capture.

all_of.description: The conditions; all must hold (AND). At least one.

to.description: Id of the phase to enter.

distance_m.description: Range between the tether root and the target in metres.

relative_speed_mps.description: Magnitude of the LVLH relative velocity in m/s.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer into the v0 document, e.g. `/states/2/transitions/0/distance/units`.

value.description: The value as the v0 file had it.

description:
A capture plan file, schema v1. Lengths are metres, speeds m/s, forces N,
masses kg; there is no unit key.

capture_sphere.description: The capture sphere. Absent: every default applies.

device.description: The capture device. Absent: every device default applies.

migrated_from_v0.description: What a migrated v0 file held that v1 has no field for (written back unchanged).

name.description: Display name shown to the user. Not used as a lookup key. Must not be blank.

phases.description: The phases in order; a capture starts in the first. At least one.

schema_version.description: File format version; `1`. A file without it is a v0 plan and is migrated on load.

tether.description: Id the tether is registered under. Must not be blank.

title: CapturePlan
